definition.description: Presence of abnormal contrast enhancement within the orbital region.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if abnormal contrast enhancement is identified within the orbit (including optic nerves, extraocular muscles, and orbital fat) from post-contrast imaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the orbital region is not evaluated or if enhancement is not mentioned in the report.
definition.name: intra_orbital_enhancement

definition.description: Presence of a mass within the orbital cavity.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine from imaging reports (e.g., MRI, CT) whether an intra-orbital mass or abnormal orbital enhancement is explicitly identified.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the orbits are not evaluated or if documentation is insufficient to determine the presence or absence of a mass.
definition.name: intra_orbital_mass

definition.description: Presence of bleeding within the cranial cavity.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract whether intracranial hemorrhage (including intraparenchymal, subdural, or epidural hemorrhage) is identified on brain imaging reports.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if imaging documentation is missing or does not explicitly evaluate for hemorrhage.
definition.name: intracranial_hemorrhage

definition.description: Presence of jugular venous distention on physical examination.
definition.measurement_definition: Determine if jugular venous distention (JVD) is documented as present or absent in the pretreatment physical examination or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the documentation is absent or ambiguous.
definition.name: jugular_venous_distention_presence

definition.description: The mutation status of the KEAP1 gene.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the mutation status of the KEAP1 gene from the molecular pathology or genomic testing section of the patient record.
definition.missing_value_rule: If KEAP1 status is not documented or cannot be determined, record as null.
definition.name: keap1_status

definition.description: The percentage of tumor cell nuclei that are positive for the Ki-67 protein, representing the proliferative growth fraction of the tumor.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical percentage associated with Ki-67 (or MIB-1) from the immunohistochemistry (IHC) or pathology report. If the value is reported as an approximation (e.g., '~30%'), extract the number as a float.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the Ki-67 proliferation index is not documented or the documentation is too ambiguous to derive a numerical value.
definition.name: ki67_proliferation_index

definition.description: Presence of knee osteoarthritis at pretreatment.
definition.measurement_definition: Identify if knee osteoarthritis is documented as a diagnosis in the patient's medical history, problem list, or clinical notes.
definition.missing_value_rule: If no mention of knee osteoarthritis is found in the patient record, the value is recorded as null.
definition.name: knee_osteoarthritis_presence

definition.description: Indication of whether the patient has any known allergies to medications.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the patient's drug allergy status. Map 'NKDA', 'No known drug allergies', or 'No drug allergies reported' to 'No'. Map any documented specific drug allergy or an affirmative statement of drug allergies to 'Yes'.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if allergy status is not documented.
definition.name: known_drug_allergies

definition.description: The proportion of mutant KRAS G12C alleles relative to the total number of alleles at that locus, typically derived from next-generation sequencing.
definition.measurement_definition: Extract the Variant Allele Frequency (VAF) specifically for the KRAS G12C mutation from molecular profiling or next-generation sequencing (NGS) reports. This is typically reported as a percentage.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the KRAS G12C mutation is not detected (wild-type), not tested, or if the VAF is not numerically specified.
definition.name: kras_g12c_variant_allele_frequency

definition.measurement_definition: Extract the numerical value of the serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) measurement from the pretreatment record.
definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if LDH is not documented or the value is ambiguous.
definition.name: ldh_level

system:
You review pretreatment candidate measurements using modeling evidence
from one outer-training fold. First identify themes across candidates; then
reconcile their roles as confounder, effect_modifier, both, or neither.
All evidence is fallible. No individual family, p-value, or support frequency is
a hard selection gate. A credible complementary signal can justify retention
even when other methods shrink it away. Do not mistake correlated aliases or
proxies for multiple independent discoveries. Themes organize evidence; they
do not establish equivalence, merge measurements, or transfer a role to every
theme member. Preserve investigator-locked roles exactly.

Treatment prediction, outcome prognosis, and confounding are distinct. Discuss
whether a candidate could be a common cause rather than an instrument or only a
prognostic factor. Effect modification needs treatment-heterogeneity evidence;
outcome main-effect importance alone does not establish it. Univariable logistic
interactions are on the log-odds scale and unadjusted for other covariates.
Orthogonal linear models, candidate R-learners, and causal forests assess the
probability/outcome scale after elastic-net nuisance adjustment. Their targets
and biases differ. A model family is evidence, not an independent replication.

Use exposure and evaluability denominators. Missing or nonconverged fits are not
negative votes. Repeated samples and folds overlap; support fractions are not
causal probabilities or formal stability-selection error guarantees. Raw and BH
p-values do not correct the upstream adaptive discovery process. Permutation
importance can be diluted by correlated alternatives and does not prove a
causal role. Compare fold consistency, methods, subsets, and conflicting facts.
Definitions and theme names cannot establish a role without the supplied
empirical evidence. Never invent an oracle, data-generating process, or hidden
truth. Return the requested JSON and cite only supplied evidence IDs.
